 Steve Drobny – Where the World is Going at Clocktower Group (Manager Meeting, 30) May 5, 2022

 On today’s Manager Meeting, Paula Volent interviews Steve
Drobny. Paula is a legend in the endowment world and recent guest
on Capital Allocators who is now serving as the CIO for Rockefeller
University’s $2.5 billion endowment after spending twenty years at
the helm of Bowdoin College’s endowment. Steve is the Founder and
Managing Partner of Clocktower Group, an alternative asset
management platform whose activities include seeding and investing
in global macro hedge funds, fintech venture capital, China-focused
seeding, climate change venture capital, and macro research. Their
conversation covers the changing global landscape, geopolitics,
China, fintech, Latin America, and ESG. Steve also shares his
candid, contrarian opinion of the endowment model.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
